title: Reject valid same-sequence history swaps between gameplay pre-read and atomic commit
purpose: Ensure the committed gameplay transaction still refers to exactly the validated pre-read history, not merely any valid same-clock replacement.
scope: app/application/gameplay-session.mjs: private pre-read history binding and exact post-replay state check
tests/gameplay_session_browser_cases.mjs: real IndexedDB same-clock valid-swap no-write regression
non_goals: No changes to frozen I07/I08/I10/I12 runtime, evidence, status, schemas or read-only UI
No exclusive writer claim or gameplay activation
No user data mutation, merge, release or personal acceptance
compatibility: Public session.read() return value and IndexedDB schema remain unchanged; only opt-in gameplay session writes gain a fail-closed history-swap check.
security: Rejects a valid but replaced historical event with identical sequence and Lamport within the authoritative write transaction, and rejects mismatched projected post-commit state. Generic I08 append remains an independent bypass and requires controlled REOPEN.
test_plan: real Chromium 16-case session regression including valid same-clock swap and zero mutation
frozen I08/I10 and prerelease matrix regression; I12 fingerprint remains a known blocker
rollback: Revert this isolated development commit. No user worlds, schemas or frozen checkpoint evidence were changed.
